integrity: All prime powers and dimensions follow from symbolic proof; finite checker data are corroborative. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only one-coordinate Fourier frequencies on GL_m(F_q), m>=3; no statement on higher rank frequencies or nonuniform weighting. Rank-one/two Fourier coefficient ingredients are previously known; historical priority of the combined Gram diagonalization has not been independently certified.
title: Exact coordinate Fourier frames on invertible finite-field matrices
